newsitems.title: Raft 1.1: Cross-play sails to the default branch!
newsitems.author: SVEN BENGT
newsitems.contents: [p]Hey Rafters![/p][p]Since we released Raft on Xbox Series X/S and Playstation 5 last year there has been a Beta Branch here on Steam that enables cross-play, letting Rafters who chose to opt in play with their friends who might play on Xbox or Playstation. See, when we built the support for cross play into the PC version, quite a bit of code and systems had to be overhauled and rewritten, and we knew there could be a few issues that arose once we launched. This is why we let it sit on its own branch on Steam, so that players who wanted to try cross-play could choose to do so, knowing there might be a bug here and there. During the time since it landed on the beta branch, and thanks to everyone who has played and supplied us with logs and bug reports, we have updated the cross-play version to where it is now in a state where we feel comfortable moving it over to the default branch. So now, everyone on the default branch will have access to not only cross-play, but also full controller support, in-game voice chat, bug fixes, optimized performance in many areas of the game and a whole bunch of quality of life changes.[/p][p][/p][p]However, seeing as there are going to be a lot more players sailing the cross-play waters now that it is out on the default branch, we want to cover all angles and provide a backup solution for those who might encounter a stray bug. To this end, if you for some reason want to go back to the previous version of Raft, you can do so by simply switching over to the "1.09_precrossplayupdate" branch. This will NOT cause worlds that are saved in the new version to be unplayable. More instructions below. [/p][p][/p][p]As always, if you encounter any issue, please head over to our [url="https://discord.com/invite/raft"]Discord[/url] and let us know![/p][p][/p][p]We hope you have a great time sailing the seas, maybe even with some new cross platform friends?[/p][p][/p][p]How to switch to the "1.09_precrossplayupdate" branch:[/p][p]1. Go to your Steam Library, right click Raft and choose Properties.[/p][p]2. In the new window, navigate to Game Versions & Betas on the left hand panel.[/p][p]3. Choose '1.09_precrossplayupdate'.[/p][p]4. Restart Steam to make sure the game updates.[/p]

newsitems.title: Raft Beta Branch 1.1.08
newsitems.author: SVEN BENGT
newsitems.contents: [p]Hey Rafters![/p][p][/p][p]As some of you know, we have a Beta branch for the PC version of Raft here on Steam which, among some other quality of life changes, lets you cross-play together with rafters on PlayStation and/or Xbox. We just released a small patch for the Beta branch which fixes a few bugs and adds some more voice chat options.[/p][p]We are currently trying to pinpoint an annoying bug that has been popping up among some of the players on the Beta branch and we would love if you could give us a hand in trying to find the issue! So, what do you need to do? Easy, just hop over to the Beta branch, play as you normally would, and let us know over at our discord if you encounter any issues.  It's especially interesting for us if you get an error message when trying to join a friends world, saying "error 63". [/p][p][/p][p]If you want to try the Beta branch, please follow these steps;[/p][p][/p][p]1. Go to your Steam Library, right click Raft and choose Properties.[/p][p]2. In the new window, navigate to Betas on the left hand panel.[/p][p]3. In the Beta Participation drop-down menu, choose 'beta'.[/p][p]4. Restart Steam to make sure the game updates.[/p][p][/p][p]Thank you![/p]

newsitems.title: Raft Juicer recipes and how to craft it
newsitems.author: editor@pcgamesn.com
newsitems.contents:
If you're playing this open-water survival game, you need to make sure you get a Raft Juicer. Why? Because it greatly quenches your thirst, it gives you an anti-thirst bonus, and it's a fun way to display your fruit collection. If you manage to get your hands on the Spicy Pineberry or Redbeet Shot recipes, you can even get a swimming speed bonus or health bonus respectively.

The basics are simple: place up to four types of fruit on the Raft Juicer table, and press 'start cooking' to create a drink. When the drink is done (this takes a few seconds), equip a Drinking Glass and fill it up. Of course, make sure the Juicer has a battery, but beware: don't use random fruit. You can find most of the Juicer recipes in loot boxes, but the Spicy Pineberry and Redbeet Shot are bought from the Trading Post using Raft Trash Cubes. Want to try crafting in another game? Turn your attention to the Grow a Garden recipes list to get started in a similarly delicious Roblox adventure.

newsitems.title: Playstation® 5, XBOX and Cross-Play!
newsitems.author: SVEN BENGT
newsitems.contents:
The survival classic Raft is officially setting sail on the PS5 and XBOX SERIES X/S this December 4th as a surprise release!
Console players can now experience the thrill of survival at sea from the comfort of their couches. Build, scavenge, and explore the vast open ocean with all the immersive features that the PS5 and XBOX SERIES X/S has to offer.

[h1]Steam Version Updates![/h1]
There is also some great news for all you PC players! A new version of the game is available on the Raft Beta Branch that lets you enjoy the open ocean in new ways!

[h2]Cross-play[/h2]
Survival is better with friends! Crossplay ensures that you can join forces with players across platforms, uniting the entire community in the quest for survival.

[h2]Controller Support[/h2]
If you want to enjoy Raft on the big screen, or simply just put your mouse and keyboard to the side, you can finally lean back and enjoy full controller support!

[h2]In Game Voice Chat[/h2]
Communication is key when venturing out onto the great seas! That is why we have now added crisply clear voice chat support, directly in Raft! 

[h2]Opt in![/h2]
Adding all these features means shuffling around a bit in the good ol’ code base. To be on the safe side, all these new features will currently only be available on our Beta branch here on Steam. This lets us stress test the new features, gather your feedback and make sure everything is as it should once we release it to the masses.   

So, if you want to try the new version follow these steps;

[olist]
[*] Go to your Steam Library, right click Raft and choose Properties.
[*] In the new window, navigate to Betas on the left hand panel.
[*] In the Beta Participation drop-down menu, choose 'beta'.
[*] Restart Steam to make sure the game updates.
[/olist]

[b]WARNING![/b]
The Beta branch is a test version of the update. Please back up your save files before proceeding, as this version may contain bugs that could corrupt game data.

newsitems.title: 93% rated survival game blows up on Steam thanks to huge discount
newsitems.author: editor@pcgamesn.com
newsitems.contents:
There are a handful of very big names in the survival game genre: Rust, Minecraft, DayZ, Subnautica, and, more recently, Palworld, Enshrouded, and Sons of the Forest. There's also Raft, which has plenty in common with the games listed above, and has continued to attract interest over the years since it was in and out of Steam Early Access thanks to its aquatic setting, multiplayer features, and narrative. Recently, its already healthy player numbers have shot up even further, too, as the result of it receiving a hefty limited time discount on Steam.

newsitems.title: Plushies and Consoles?
newsitems.author: SVEN BENGT
newsitems.contents:
Hey Rafters! It has been a while since Raft left Early Access and the Final Chapter was released! It has been amazing to see all the great feedback, your reactions to the finale of the story and the incredible rafts you all have been building. Please keep them coming! 

We are happy to announce that we have partnered up with Makeship to release a one time limited edition set of plushies! Up until November 15, you can get yourself a cuddly version of the Raft Shark, Maya or the Pufferfish! Or perhaps all three? You can find the storepage right [url=https://www.makeship.com/shop/creator/raft]here![/url]
 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30560232/c77a7364d3bd0700cd133e049f2f94e923bae229.png[/img]


[h2]Consoles?[/h2]
And for even more exciting news, we can finally announce that we are actively working on getting Raft onto consoles! We strive to be able to release it on as many platforms as possible and hope we can give as many players as possible the chance to build their own raft! We want the console experience to be just as good as the PC game, and make sure that everything looks and feels as good as possible, and that takes a bit of time. Therefore it is too early to give you a time of release, but we will let you know as soon as we can! Many of you have asked for it and we hope you are as excited as we are!

We will let you know as soon as we have more to share!

Until next time!

//Raft HQ

newsitems.title: Hotfix - Raft 1.08
newsitems.author: SVEN BENGT
newsitems.contents:
[h2]CHANGELOG[/h2]
[list]
[*] Rhino shark will now go to the next level as soon as one pillar is destroyed, instead of waiting for the player to go to the next level
[*] Added Sort into Storage button in storag UI. This button will check for items in your inventory that matches items in the storage and move those items to the storage. Does not move items that have durability or consume stacks
[/list]

[h2]BUG FIXES[/h2]
[list]
[*] Issue where Varuna Point Rhino Shark disappears
[*] Issue where removing Rhino Shark trophy would destroy nearby blocks
[*] issue where Engines disappeared randomly
[*] Rouhi had no visuals for certain equippables
[/list]

newsitems.title: Raft review
newsitems.author: Christopher Livingston
newsitems.contents: Our oceans are clogged with plastic trash, but here's a small silver lining: All that garbage is keeping me alive. In open world survival game Raft, which spent four years in early access before hitting 1.0 in June, I turned a collection of floating trash into a floating base—a big, cluttered, ugly floating base, but it's packed with life-saving amenities and I've slowly come to love it like a home... Read more.
